newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle prices fully steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle prices fully steady - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were fully steady, with demand and seller interest fair-good. Confirmed - 7,000 Last Week - 4,700 Last Year - 19,000
Wk To Date- 78,500 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 100,000 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 72,500
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs - 64.00-65.00; dressed basis 104.00, couple pens predominately Choice 105.00. ( weighted average 104.05).
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs - 64.00-65.00; dressed basis 104.00, pen 104.50. ( weighted average 104.01).
For the week - Slaughter steers and heifers on a live and dressed basis fully steady.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
